description.value: Mucho Burrito is a Canadian fast-casual Mexican chain emphasizing fresh, house-made ingredients across burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas. With vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options throughout the menu, it offers meaningful flexibility for cyclists with dietary needs. This Vancouver-area location is part of a network of 140+ Canadian outlets.
